name: doc-sync-guard
description: Always-on documentation synchronization rules: update READMEs, indexes, CLI flags, cross-references, and measured stats in the same turn as code or data changes, while preserving cross-platform parity across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
suggestedPrompts: Audit recent code and config changes in this workspace and synchronize all affected docs and index tables
Verify that every path link, CLI command, and metric in README.md matches the current repository state
Add the newly created scripts and modules into the top-level documentation index
